summary: Follow a storefront request through a single Rails deployment with explicit module boundaries.
scope: A teaching model inspired by Shopify’s published modularity work. Module names and request paths are illustrative, not an inventory of the current platform.
author: Thoth

componentNotes.client: Browses the storefront and submits checkout requests.
componentNotes.edge: Receives storefront traffic and routes dynamic requests to Rails.
componentNotes.app: Hosts commerce modules in one deployment with explicit interfaces.
componentNotes.catalog: Owns product lookup and exposes its results through a module API.
componentNotes.checkout: Coordinates a purchase through inventory and order boundaries.
componentNotes.inventory: Reserves stock before checkout confirms the order.
componentNotes.db: Stores product, inventory and order data behind module boundaries.
componentNotes.jobs: Queues follow-up work outside the checkout response.
componentNotes.worker: Handles the receipt job independently of the shopper request.
